privacy:
This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Tradesly ("we", "us") collects, how we use it, who we share it with, and your rights under the UK General Data Protection Regulation (UK GDPR) and the Data Protection Act 2018.

The short version: We collect the details you submit when requesting a quote (name, postcode, email, phone, problem description). We share them with one matched local tradesperson so they can send you quotes. We charge partners for introductions; we do not sell your details for unrelated marketing, and we never share it without your explicit consent. You can request deletion at any time by emailing hello@tradesly.co.uk.

1. Who we are

Tradesly is a UK-based quote-matching service operated by AireyAI Limited. We connect homeowners with vetted local tradespeople. We are the data controller for personal data submitted through this website.

Contact: hello@tradesly.co.uk

2. What data we collect

Data you submit voluntarily

  • Name (when provided in the problem field)
  • Postcode (used to match you with local tradespeople)
  • Email address (so matched tradespeople can contact you)
  • Phone number (optional — speeds up callbacks if you provide it)
  • WhatsApp number (optional — alternative to phone)
  • Problem description (so the tradesperson can prepare an accurate quote)
  • Consent timestamp (when you ticked the GDPR consent box)

Data collected automatically

  • IP address (for fraud prevention and rate limiting)
  • Referring page (so we know how you arrived)
  • Browser information (the request user-agent, where supplied)
  • Referral and campaign information (where supplied with your enquiry)

3. How we use your data

We use your personal data only to:

  • Match you with one suitable local tradesperson in your postcode for the trade you requested
  • Send you a confirmation email asking you to verify your enquiry (so we don't waste tradespeople's time on bot submissions)
  • Pass your details to the matched garden partner using the agreed contact method
  • Detect and prevent fraudulent submissions
  • Improve our matching algorithm (using anonymised aggregate data only)

Lawful basis: We rely on your explicit consent (UK GDPR Art. 6(1)(a)) given via the consent checkbox on the form, and our legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f)) in operating the matching service and preventing fraud.

4. Who we share your data with

We share your details with:

  • One matched garden partner in your postcode for the trade you requested. They are independent businesses contracted to use your details only to provide a quote, not to add you to marketing lists.
  • Email service providers (e.g. Google Workspace, used to send confirmation and matching emails)
  • Hosting and storage providers (the public website uses GitHub Pages; enquiries are processed and stored through Cloudflare and the matching workflow)
  • Anti-fraud providers (basic IP-based checks, no third-party data enrichment)

Garden partners pay for introductions. Your enquiry is shared with one matched partner for the job you requested; it is not shared for unrelated marketing. Another introduction requires your agreement.

5. How long we keep your data

We keep enquiry and consent records for as long as they are needed for the matching service, handling disputes and meeting applicable legal obligations. Retention depends on the type of record, whether the enquiry is active, any unresolved dispute and any legal requirement to retain it. You can ask us to review or delete your information using the contact details above.

6. Your rights under UK GDPR

Under UK GDPR you have the following rights at any time:

  • Right of access — request a copy of all personal data we hold about you
  • Right to rectification — correct any inaccurate data
  • Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten") — request deletion of your personal data
  • Right to restriction — limit how we process your data
  • Right to data portability — receive your data in a machine-readable format
  • Right to object — to processing based on legitimate interests
  • Right to withdraw consent — at any time, with no penalty

To exercise any of these rights, email hello@tradesly.co.uk. We handle rights requests within the applicable legal response period.

7. Cookies

The redesigned public enquiry pages do not set analytics, advertising or social tracking cookies. The form keeps your draft in the open page while you complete it; it does not store your contact details in browser storage. Website providers may process technical request information to deliver and protect the service.

8. Children

Tradesly is not intended for use by anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect data from children. If you believe a minor has submitted data, contact us and we will delete it.

9. International data transfers

Some of our service providers (e.g. email hosting) may process your data outside the UK. Where this happens, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place under UK GDPR Chapter V (Standard Contractual Clauses or equivalent adequacy decisions).

10. Complaints

If you are unhappy with how we handle your data, please contact us first at hello@tradesly.co.uk — we'll do our best to resolve it.

You also have the right to complain to the UK regulator, the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO):

  • Website: ico.org.uk/make-a-complaint
  • Phone: 0303 123 1113

11. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top will reflect the most recent change. Material changes will be flagged on the homepage.
terms:
These Terms govern your use of Tradesly (tradesly.co.uk and related services), operated by AireyAI Limited. By using the service you agree to these Terms. There are two parts: Homeowner Terms (Sections 1–6) and Tradesperson Partner Terms (Sections 7–13).

The short version: Tradesly is a matching service that introduces homeowners to local tradespeople. We don't carry out the work — that's between you and the tradesperson. We're free for homeowners. Tradespeople pay us per qualified lead, with a 24-hour dispute window for fakes.

1. What Tradesly is (and isn't)

Tradesly is a quote-matching service. We review Bristol and nearby BS-postcode garden enquiries and, where a suitable partner is available, introduce the homeowner to one local garden partner. A request does not guarantee a match, quote or response time.

We are not:

  • A contractor or tradesperson — we don't do any work ourselves
  • An employer of the tradespeople — they are independent businesses
  • A guarantor of work quality — see Section 5
  • A directory or listing site — partner applications are reviewed before introductions begin

2. Eligibility (homeowners)

To use Tradesly as a homeowner you must be:

  • At least 18 years old
  • The owner or authorised occupier of the UK property the work is for
  • Authorised to share the property and contact details you submit

3. Service is free for homeowners

Tradesly is and always will be free for homeowners. We do not charge you to request quotes, receive matches, or use any feature of the service. Tradespeople pay us a small matching fee for receiving your details — this never affects what they charge you.

4. The matching process

When you submit a quote request:

  • We match you with one suitable local garden partner covering your postcode
  • With your consent, we share your contact details and job description with one matched garden partner
  • The matched partner contacts you directly to discuss your job and quote
  • You decide whether to proceed after discussing the work and price with the partner
  • You contract directly with the tradesperson — Tradesly is not a party to that contract

5. Quality, liability & disputes (homeowners)

We review partner applications and suitability before introductions. You should independently check relevant experience, insurance and recent work before booking. In particular:

  • The work itself is performed by the tradesperson under their own contract with you
  • Tradesly is not liable for the quality, timing, or outcome of the work
  • Disputes about the work itself are between you and the tradesperson
  • If a Tradesly tradesperson lets you down, please tell us — we review concerns and may pause partner introductions

Nothing in these Terms limits any rights you have under UK consumer law (Consumer Rights Act 2015 or otherwise).

6. Acceptable use (homeowners)

You agree not to:

  • Submit false or misleading details
  • Submit requests for properties you don't own or aren't authorised to act for
  • Use the service to spam tradespeople or test/probe the platform
  • Use Tradesly for any unlawful purpose

We may refuse, suspend, or remove submissions that breach this section, including blocking your IP or email if necessary.

7. Tradesperson Partner Terms — eligibility

To join Tradesly as a tradesperson partner you must:

  • Operate a UK-registered business (sole trader, partnership, or limited company)
  • Hold all required certifications for your trade (e.g. Gas Safe for gas work, MCS for heat pumps and solar, NICEIC for electrical, CISRS for scaffolding)
  • Hold appropriate public liability insurance (minimum £2m, £5m recommended)
  • Provide accurate information at sign-up about your business, postcodes, daily cap, and tier acceptance

We verify these details before accepting partners. Misrepresentation may result in immediate removal and recovery of any leads delivered.

8. How leads are priced & delivered

Leads are graded into four tiers based on qualification depth:

  • Tier 1 (Cold): garden enquiry submitted with basic details — £25
  • Tier 2 (Verified): homeowner confirms their interest — £45
  • Tier 3 (Quote-ready): timeframe and clarified project — £70
  • Tier 4 (Detailed): additional supporting project detail — £110

The initial service covers garden and landscaping jobs in BS postcode areas. Your tier acceptance, prices, coverage and delivery arrangements are agreed before paid introductions begin. A delivered lead does not guarantee a booking or a sale.

9. The 24-hour dispute window

You may dispute any lead within 24 hours of delivery for any of the following reasons:

  • Contact details are fake or unreachable
  • Lead is outside your declared postcode coverage
  • Lead has already engaged a different tradesperson
  • Lead is a duplicate of one already delivered to you
  • Lead is for work you don't cover

We review reported fake, duplicate or otherwise ineligible leads under these criteria. Approved disputes are excluded from billing or credited. Repeated disputes may trigger a review of the source or partner arrangement.

Disputes received after 24 hours are at our discretion.

10. Billing

Billing and payment arrangements are agreed with you before paid introductions start. Charges cover delivered leads at the agreed tier price, less approved credits. Outstanding charges and any suspension arrangements are set out in that agreement.

Your first 3 qualifying leads in your selected niches and postcodes are free as a trial. Standard pricing applies thereafter.

11. Exclusive introductions and no job commission

We charge a flat per-lead fee and do not take a percentage of the work agreed with the homeowner. Each enquiry is offered exclusively to one matched partner. We do not sell the same enquiry to multiple businesses. If another introduction is needed, the homeowner’s agreement is required first.

12. Pause & cancellation

You can pause your partner account at any time by emailing hello@tradesly.co.uk. There is no notice period. We confirm the pause and stop new introductions; already-delivered leads remain payable per your invoice cycle.

You can cancel your account entirely at any time. Outstanding invoices remain payable.

13. Tradesperson conduct & data use

By accepting leads, you agree to:

  • Use lead contact details only to provide a quote for the requested work — not for marketing, mailing lists, or any unrelated purpose
  • Respond to leads within a reasonable timeframe (typically 24 hours)
  • Provide quotes that match what you'd quote any other customer (no inflated pricing)
  • Comply with UK GDPR in your handling of homeowner data
  • Not contact a homeowner after they've engaged a different tradesperson

Breaches of this section may result in account suspension, removal, and legal action where appropriate.

14. Intellectual property

All content on tradesly.co.uk (logo, branding, copy, design, code) is the property of AireyAI Limited unless otherwise stated. You may not copy, reproduce, or scrape the site without written permission.

15. Disclaimers & liability

The service is provided "as is". To the fullest extent permitted by law, we exclude all warranties not expressly stated in these Terms. Nothing in these Terms limits liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence, fraud, or anything that cannot be excluded under English law.

Our total liability to any homeowner is capped at £100. Our total liability to any tradesperson partner is capped at the total fees they have paid us in the prior 12 months.

16. Changes to these Terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. Material changes will be notified by email (for partners) or flagged on the homepage (for homeowners). Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance.

17. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales. Any disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales, except that nothing prevents homeowners or partners from bringing proceedings in their own jurisdiction where required by mandatory consumer protection law.

18. Contact

Questions about these Terms? Email hello@tradesly.co.uk.
